mapper.select:
select ifnull(sum(case p.`month` when 01 then ifnull(p.totalNum,0) end),0) '1', ifnull(sum(case p.`month` when 02 then ifnull(p.totalNum,0) end),0) '2', ifnull(sum(case p.`month` when 03 then ifnull(p.totalNum,0) end),0) '3', ifnull(sum(case p.`month` when 04 then ifnull(p.totalNum,0) end),0) '4', ifnull(sum(case p.`month` when 05 then ifnull(p.totalNum,0) end),0) '5', ifnull(sum(case p.`month` when 06 then ifnull(p.totalNum,0) end),0) '6', ifnull(sum(case p.`month` when 07 then ifnull(p.totalNum,0) end),0) '7', ifnull(sum(case p.`month` when 08 then ifnull(p.totalNum,0) end),0) '8', ifnull(sum(case p.`month` when 09 then ifnull(p.totalNum,0) end),0) '9', ifnull(sum(case p.`month` when 10 then ifnull(p.totalNum,0) end),0) '10', ifnull(sum(case p.`month` when 11 then ifnull(p.totalNum,0) end),0) '11', ifnull(sum(case p.`month` when 12 then ifnull(p.totalNum,0) end),0) '12' from ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.receiving_time,"%Y") `year`, DATE_FORMAT(o.receiving_time,"%m") `month`, od.details_num totalNum, omp.materiel_num offNum FROM brt_market_order o INNER JOIN brt_market_order_details od on od.order_id = o.order_id left join brt_order_materiel_plan omp on omp.order_details_id = od.details_id )p
where p.`year` = #{map.queryYear} GROUP BY p.`year`

select ifnull(sum(case p.`month` when 01 then ifnull(p.offNum,0) end),0) '1', ifnull(sum(case p.`month` when 02 then ifnull(p.offNum,0) end),0) '2', ifnull(sum(case p.`month` when 03 then ifnull(p.offNum,0) end),0) '3', ifnull(sum(case p.`month` when 04 then ifnull(p.offNum,0) end),0) '4', ifnull(sum(case p.`month` when 05 then ifnull(p.offNum,0) end),0) '5', ifnull(sum(case p.`month` when 06 then ifnull(p.offNum,0) end),0) '6', ifnull(sum(case p.`month` when 07 then ifnull(p.offNum,0) end),0) '7', ifnull(sum(case p.`month` when 08 then ifnull(p.offNum,0) end),0) '8', ifnull(sum(case p.`month` when 09 then ifnull(p.offNum,0) end),0) '9', ifnull(sum(case p.`month` when 10 then ifnull(p.offNum,0) end),0) '10', ifnull(sum(case p.`month` when 11 then ifnull(p.offNum,0) end),0) '11', ifnull(sum(case p.`month` when 12 then ifnull(p.offNum,0) end),0) '12' from ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.receiving_time,"%Y") `year`, DATE_FORMAT(o.receiving_time,"%m") `month`, od.details_num totalNum, omp.materiel_num offNum FROM brt_market_order o INNER JOIN brt_market_order_details od on od.order_id = o.order_id left join brt_order_materiel_plan omp on omp.order_details_id = od.details_id )p
where p.`year` = #{map.queryYear} GROUP BY p.`year`

select ifnull(sum(case when p.type="s" and p.`month` = 01 then p.amount end),0) '1' , ifnull(sum(case when p.type="s" and p.`month` = 02 then p.amount end),0) '2' , ifnull(sum(case when p.type="s" and p.`month` = 03 then p.amount end),0) '3' , ifnull(sum(case when p.type="s" and p.`month` = 04 then p.amount end),0) '4' , ifnull(sum(case when p.type="s" and p.`month` = 05 then p.amount end),0) '5' , ifnull(sum(case when p.type="s" and p.`month` = 06 then p.amount end),0) '6' , ifnull(sum(case when p.type="s" and p.`month` = 07 then p.amount end),0) '7' , ifnull(sum(case when p.type="s" and p.`month` = 08 then p.amount end),0) '8' , ifnull(sum(case when p.type="s" and p.`month` = 09 then p.amount end),0) '9' , ifnull(sum(case when p.type="s" and p.`month` = 10 then p.amount end),0) '10' , ifnull(sum(case when p.type="s" and p.`month` = 11 then p.amount end),0) '11' , ifnull(sum(case when p.type="s" and p.`month` = 12 then p.amount end),0) '12' from ( SELECT "s" type, -- 收支类型 （s:收入，z:支出） DATE_FORMAT(update_time,"%Y") `year`, -- 年份 DATE_FORMAT(update_time,"%m") `month`, -- 月份 collection_amount amount FROM brt_order_collection_record
UNION ALL
SELECT if(check_type='0','z','s') type, DATE_FORMAT(create_time,"%Y") `year`, -- 年份 DATE_FORMAT(create_time,"%m") `month`, -- 月份 check_amount amount FROM brt_check )p
and p.`year` = #{map.queryYear}

select ifnull(sum(case when p.type="z" and p.`month` = 01 then p.amount end),0) '1' , ifnull(sum(case when p.type="z" and p.`month` = 02 then p.amount end),0) '2' , ifnull(sum(case when p.type="z" and p.`month` = 03 then p.amount end),0) '3' , ifnull(sum(case when p.type="z" and p.`month` = 04 then p.amount end),0) '4' , ifnull(sum(case when p.type="z" and p.`month` = 05 then p.amount end),0) '5' , ifnull(sum(case when p.type="z" and p.`month` = 06 then p.amount end),0) '6' , ifnull(sum(case when p.type="z" and p.`month` = 07 then p.amount end),0) '7' , ifnull(sum(case when p.type="z" and p.`month` = 08 then p.amount end),0) '8' , ifnull(sum(case when p.type="z" and p.`month` = 09 then p.amount end),0) '9' , ifnull(sum(case when p.type="z" and p.`month` = 10 then p.amount end),0) '10' , ifnull(sum(case when p.type="z" and p.`month` = 11 then p.amount end),0) '11' , ifnull(sum(case when p.type="z" and p.`month` = 12 then p.amount end),0) '12' from ( SELECT "s" type, -- 收支类型 （s:收入，z:支出） DATE_FORMAT(update_time,"%Y") `year`, -- 年份 DATE_FORMAT(update_time,"%m") `month`, -- 月份 collection_amount amount FROM brt_order_collection_record
UNION ALL
SELECT if(check_type='0','z','s') type, DATE_FORMAT(create_time,"%Y") `year`, -- 年份 DATE_FORMAT(create_time,"%m") `month`, -- 月份 check_amount amount FROM brt_check )p
and p.`year` = #{map.queryYear}

select count(*) from ( SELECT so.order_id orderId, sum(ifnull( omp.order_num, 0 )) orderNum, sum(ifnull( omp.materiel_num, 0 )) materielNum FROM brt_sales_order so inner join brt_customer_delivery cd on cd.order_id = so.order_id INNER JOIN brt_sales_order_details sod ON sod.order_id = so.order_id INNER JOIN brt_order_materiel_plan omp ON omp.order_details_id = sod.details_id and omp.order_node_id = cd.order_node_id GROUP BY so.order_id )p where p.orderNum-p.materielNum >0

select count(p.delivery_id) from ( SELECT cd.delivery_id FROM brt_sales_order so INNER JOIN brt_customer_delivery cd ON cd.order_id = so.order_id INNER JOIN brt_sales_order_details sod ON sod.order_id = so.order_id INNER JOIN brt_order_materiel_plan omp ON omp.order_details_id = sod.details_id AND omp.order_node_id = cd.order_node_id where (omp.update_time < so.delivery_time or so.delivery_time = null) GROUP BY so.order_id )p

SELECT m.materiel_no materielNo, m.materiel_name materielName, m.materiel_spec materielSpec, m.materiel_unit materielUnit, ob.total_num totalNum
FROM brt_order_boom ob LEFT JOIN brt_materiel m ON m.materiel_id = ob.materiel_id where ob.order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT m.materiel_no materielNo, m.materiel_name materielName, m.materiel_spec materielSpec, m.materiel_unit materielUnit, iim.in_inventory_num inInventoryNum
FROM brt_in_inventory ii left join brt_in_inventory_materiel iim on iim.in_inventory_id = ii.in_inventory_id left join brt_materiel m on m.materiel_id = iim.materiel_id where ii.in_inventory_id = #{inInventoryId}

SELECT m.materiel_no materielNo, m.materiel_name materielName, m.materiel_spec materielSpec, m.materiel_unit materielUnit, iim.out_inventory_num outInventoryNum
FROM brt_out_inventory ii left join brt_out_inventory_materiel iim on iim.out_inventory_id = ii.out_inventory_id left join brt_materiel m on m.materiel_id = iim.materiel_id where ii.out_inventory_id = #{outInventoryId}

SELECT c.customer_name customerName, if(m.materiel_name is null,od.materiel_id,m.materiel_name) materielName, m.materiel_spec spec, od.materiel_unit unit, od.details_num num, od.details_remark remark, od.customer_pn customerPn, so.order_no orderNo FROM brt_sales_order so LEFT JOIN brt_sales_order_details od ON so.order_id = od.order_id left join brt_materiel m on m.materiel_id = od.materiel_id left join brt_customer c on c.customer_id = so.customer_id where so.order_id = #{orderId}
